title: Bind gate approval to exact cell packets
action: Add a gate preview mode that reads the feature worktree plan, parses the exact JSON cell packet, validates required execution fields, and records its plan hash. Refuse shape approval without a fresh preview. Compare cells add input with the approved packet. Update the planning source skill and verification map, then run the required regen chain.

truths: The preview output shows action, files, read_first, must_haves, and exact verify for every current cell
Shape approval refuses a missing or stale preview
Cells add refuses a packet that differs from the approved preview
Gate and advisor reads use the feature worktree plan

artifacts.substantive: parses, validates, hashes, and renders preview packets

key_links: gate preview stores the plan hash that approval checks
cells add compares against the packet approved for the current plan revision
prohibitions: Do not persist cells before execution approval
Do not accept a guessed or malformed packet
Do not hand-edit generated skill trees

checks.evidence: The approved packet requires action, files, read_first, must_haves, and verify in docs/history/pi-harness-workflow-parity/plan.md:150-190; plan_packets.rs:81-169 validates the packet and :195-229 renders those fields. The isolated approved command `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/bee-pihp-review-target PATH=... cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee pihp_gate_packet` printed 6 passed, 0 failed.

The cell is high-risk in .bee/cells/pihp-4.json:2-6 and the plan is high-risk in docs/history/pi-harness-workflow-parity/plan.md:1-5. gate_preview_refusal reads the plan, then returns None when plan.md is missing at packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/state_group/plan_packets.rs:326-330. set_gate.rs:898-909 calls this refusal for shape or merged approval, so a high-risk approval can proceed without a plan or preview.

The approved packet lookup at packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/state_group/plan_packets.rs:365-388 reads only approved_cell_packet or gate_preview, and the add check at :391-476 compares incoming fields without reading plan.md or its hash. cells add invokes that check at packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/handlers_write.rs:178-184 and :347-353, while set_gate.rs:898-909 checks staleness only during gate approval. After approval, a changed plan can therefore still use the old packet when cells are added.

advisor_plan_path finds the granted worktree at packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/state_group/advisor_ref.rs:78-87, but returns the worktree plan only when it exists or the main plan does not exist at :88-89. If both plans exist, it falls through to the main-checkout path at :93. The gate and advisor callers use this resolver at plan_packets.rs:275 and advisor_ref.rs:118, so both can read the wrong plan.

get_approved_preview_cells prefers the stored approved_cell_packet and falls back to gate_preview at packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/state_group/plan_packets.rs:365-385. The approved packet is stamped during shape or merged approval at packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/state_group/set_gate.rs:972-977, preserving stored packet reads for unchanged historical records.

Packet validation runs before cell writes at packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/handlers_write.rs:178-184 and :343-357. The capped record contains verify_command, verify_output, verify_passed, and verification_evidence at .bee/cells/pihp-4.json:90-94, with the approved command recorded at :42 and :94.

The capped record identifies commit 0f7339ef64936f0ab7c881fd611648c940d6ac2a and its nine files at .bee/cells/pihp-4.json:103-117. `git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r 0f7339ef64936f0ab7c881fd611648c940d6ac2a` printed the same nine paths, and the feature worktree HEAD is that commit.

The approved test command printed 6 passing tests, including packet rendering, execution-field validation, approval staleness, worktree resolution with no main plan, and packet comparison. The test cases are at packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/state_group/plan_packets.rs:529-688, :692-740, and :742-784. No test covers high-risk approval with a missing plan, cells add after a plan change, or both main and worktree plans existing; those are the three failing paths above.
